run_setup_install: run python setup.py install to install the model_opt package with all dependencies
get_local_version_suffix: get the local version suffix string combining git hash and current date
write_version_file: write a version.py file containing the package version and optional git tag
get_install_requires: read and return the list of install requirements from requirements.txt
review_setup_config: review the setuptools setup configuration for the model_opt package
